TASK A: 2C SKIPPED-COPY AND MICHELLE-FIRST PATHS. Files: tests/test_2c_paths_repro.py and /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/stage5-notes/2c-paths-repro.md.
QUESTION (from .plans/implementation_plan.md Stage 5 item 4): 'Replay skipped-copy and Michelle-first 2C paths.' In scene 2C the intended order is: copy the evidence (k_sl_2c_c_r1), argue about sending it (k_sl_2c_c_r2), then decode Michelle's message (k_sl_2c_d_r1) and follow the maintenance route (k_sl_2c_d_r2). SKIPPED-COPY = the player never copies or secures the evidence. MICHELLE-FIRST = the player decodes Michelle's message and follows the route before any copy. Does either order strand a reveal, leave a wrong state, or make the scene exit text claim something the facts contradict (for example delivered text saying the evidence is copied when evidence facts say it is not)?
INVESTIGATE AND PIN: (1) Static: from the loaded package list the requires/establishes chain of every k_sl_2c_* reveal, the 2C pacing entry and the 2C handoff/bridge (data/stories/continuity-initiative/pacing.yaml, handoffs.yaml, storylet-routes.yaml), and which facts the 2C exit and every 3A reveal/handoff require, naming any that need copy-path facts. (2) Dynamic, three scripted replays through the real engine (use bench/core.py advance_state_to_scene to reach 2C; do not edit it): (a) canonical order for reference; (b) skipped-copy: never use a command matching k_sl_2c_c_r1 or c_r2 evidence (verify offline with the real matcher, as tests/test_*_spine_prompts.py do) but earn the other 2C reveals you can; (c) Michelle-first: d_r1 and d_r2 before any copy command, then the copy afterwards. For each, with a hard cap of 60 turns, report which 2C reveals were earned or rejected as ineligible (and the issue string), the exit cause (transition_cause), the authored text delivered at exit, and the values of the evidence facts (evidence_ready_to_transmit and whatever the c_r1/c_r2 establishes) at exit, then continue into 3A and report whether any 3A reveal is stranded or any 3A text presumes the copy. (3) State plainly whether each path is coherent. A mismatch between delivered text and facts is a REPRODUCED defect: pin it as a strict xfail.
